notes.title: Update + Delay Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, we have some important news: TOUCHSTARVED will no longer be releasing in 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]We're now aiming for a 2026 launch window. This is because the game has grown in scope and ambition beyond what we initially planned. We're still a small, part-time team, and we remain committed to making something beautiful without crunching. But there's also lots to be excited about! [/p][p][/p][h3]Updates[/h3][p]Chapter 1 of TOUCHSTARVED will be completed this winter We'll be sharing sneak peeks from this update down the line. We’ve expanded the game with: [/p][list][*][p][b]Chapter 1 will be completed this Winter[/b], and all Kickstarter backers will get access to this preview by the end of the year! We’ll have fun sneak peeks posted publicly for non-backers down the line, too.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’re adding [b]animated FX, background revamps, more illustrations, and an original soundtrack[/b] to the game![/p][/*][*][p]We’re [b]launching a Patreon[/b] for those who want more regular progress updates, previews, and behind-the-scenes content.[/p][/*][/list][p]For full details on these updates, including our development tracker and Patreon launch info, please visit [url="https://redspring.studio/updates/ts-delay-announcement" buttoncolor="#c70000"]our site[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and patience. We’re so grateful to have such a passionate community behind us![/p][p]— The Red Spring Studio Team [/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 2.0 Patch
notes.content: [hr][/hr][p]A patch for demo 2.0 is now live![/p][p]This update addresses various bugs and issues introduced in Demo Version 2.0[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where save data failed to load the correct backgrounds in scenes when the game was closed and reopened.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various instances where sprites were displayed incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Several typos have been corrected throughout the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked some descriptions based on player feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Route Selection Screen so Vere’s art is no longer stretched.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to everyone who submitted bugs and helped us solve these issues. If you encounter any more issues or bugs when playing the demo, please report them using [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe61yusvpXA90SWnhyjrOg1bjR6eF91tAOh-3c1z-F6kcLuLQ/viewform"]this form[/url]. Thank you so much for playing![/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Patch 2 for the demo is now live! Please visit our site for [url=https://www.redspring.studio/updates]full patch notes[/url].[/th]
    [/tr]

Please be advised that due to fundamental changes to the game’s scripts and save data, your previous saves will not work in Demo 2.0. We apologize for this inconvenience.

If you notice any new loading screens, this is completely normal and the result of several engine level updates to our game. 

If you encounter any issues or bugs when playing the demo, please report them [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe61yusvpXA90SWnhyjrOg1bjR6eF91tAOh-3c1z-F6kcLuLQ/viewform]using this form[/url]. Thank you so much for playing!

[b]⚠ WARNING: Some of the notes below may contain slight spoilers for new content. Please read at your own risk.[/b]

[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced the Hound origin with the Exile origin. This brand new backstory gives MC the ability to understand Soulless and unlocks unique insight into certain situations.
[*] Made significant changes to Leander’s post-tavern scene to better set up his full route and to give him a chance to scope out your room.
[*] Added unlockable red choices with new content to both Kuras and Vere’s post-tavern scenes.
[*] Polished all scenes and dialogue with the help of our wonderful editor.
[*] Tweaked several scenes to keep information and characterization consistent.
[*] Added new sprite expressions. Leander in particular is feeling a lot more expressive now that his novocaine has worn off.
[*] Added a short new scene after Leander’s introduction. Please enjoy your stay at the Wet Wick.
[*] Leander’s club has been renamed to the Adderstone. No, it’s not suspicious at all.
[*] Added new choices and additional dialogue to Vere’s introduction scene. We hope you enjoy giving him a hard time.
[*] Added a choice for you to fight the Soulless when you’re reunited in Lowtown, but we really wouldn’t recommend it.
[*] Added additional dialogue to Mhin’s introduction scene. Everyone deserves a chance to talk about their hobbies.
[*] Added additional dialogue to Ais’s post-tavern scene. It’s small, but good luck unlocking it.
[*] Added new content to Vere’s post-tavern scene.
[*] We’ve given Vere a snack to curb his bloodthirsty tendencies. Now he’s far less likely to turn you into dessert, unless you’re into that.
[*] Added new background art. Can you find the new locations?
[*] Added a hotkey: pressing Esc after the “Made in Unity” screen will skip directly to the title menu.
[*] Updated the Mac readme document to have clearer installation instructions.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused player variables (background, pronouns) to persist between save files.
[*] Fixed various typos and visual bugs from the previous demo version.
[/list]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Skip mode turns off after a loading screen when set to “Read Only.” Simply turn it back on to continue using skip mode, or set skip mode to “Everything.”
[*] Bugged interactions between the skip and rewind functions. 
[*] We lowered default skip speed and capped the number of lines that can be rewound to reduce these issues, but they may still occur.
[*] Please turn off skip mode before trying to rewind lines.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the new version of the demo:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the bug causing the Enter key to skip all choices
[*] Added information about keyboard and mouse controls when beginning a New Game from the title menu
[*] Fixed minor typos
[/olist]
Thank you for your patience and for contacting us about these issues. We hope you enjoy TOUCHSTARVED!
